description.value:
The margins of this clothbound journal's pages are filled with complaints on all manner of topics, shifting to match whatever angers the bearer most.

Activate—Air Grievance 1 (concentrate, curse, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect You inscribe the name or description of a creature you can see that has wronged you in some way. If your next action is to target that creature with a prepared spell with the curse trait that requires a saving throw, the creature also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 2} unless it critically succeeds its saving throw.
